437:t_1:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Wake up, $n. You can see $$翠の地球$$ so clearly from here.」

437:t_1:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「This is no time to sleep. We're about to fight the $$新地球皇国$$ on $$蒼の地球$$.」

437:t_1:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Keep trying to talk to him.」

437:t_1:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「His brain isn't damaged. $n is just in a deep sleep right now.」

437:t_1:13.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I heard that if both eyes become those $$血塗られた眼$$, your mind dies...」

437:t_1:14.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$刹那$$... Will $n ever wake up again?」

437:t_1:16.en:
$$刹那$$
「This isn't $$スフィアの反作用$$... I think $n's mind broke under too many shocks, one after another.」

437:t_1:17.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If the backlash leaves you stuck between hope and despair, then he's fallen into despair now...」

437:t_1:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「The fight with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... And what happened with $$マキ#pilot$$...」

437:t_1:20.en:
$$カレン$$
「Hey! Do you even understand what's happening right now?!」

437:t_1:22.en:
$$カレン$$
「No, you don't! You don't know how much despair $n has fought, or how he's drowning in it now!」

437:t_1:23.en:
$$ティティ$$
「But it's true. I thought $n was a much more impressive kid. I'm disappointed.」

437:t_1:25.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Stop it, $$カレン$$. ...And you stop too, $$ティティ$$.」

437:t_1:27.en:
$$甲児$$
「...Hey, $$ティティ$$... You talked to $$マキ#pilot$$ at $$ターミナル・ベース$$, right?」

437:t_1:28.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Yeah... She told me all sorts of things about $n back when he went to school.」

437:t_1:29.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Did you notice anything strange then?」

437:t_1:30.en:
$$ティティ$$
「What do you mean by strange...?」

437:t_1:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「Did she seem sneaky, like she was trying to trick us? Or act oddly because she felt guilty...?」

437:t_1:32.en:
$$ティティ$$
「No, nothing like that. If anything, she seemed to be enjoying herself.」

437:t_1:34.en:
$$さやか$$
「I wonder if she was happy to be free...」

437:t_1:35.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll ask her myself the next time we meet.」

437:t_1:36.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll ask why she's with $$クロノ$$, and whether she approached $n knowing who he was.」

437:t_1:37.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But $$クロウ$$ and $$ランド$$ said something.」

437:t_1:38.en:
$$アマタ$$
「They said, judging by that $$ブルー$$ person's attitude, even the members hadn't expected to fight us until that moment...」

437:t_1:39.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ decided it on the spot?」

437:t_1:40.en:
$$フェルト$$
「And they carried it out without questioning him at all...」

437:t_1:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「We still don't know what $$クロノ$$ wants, and now even the Reformists we thought were on our side have done this...」

437:t_1:42.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Then the only one we can count on is $$クィーン$$, who calls herself the third $$クロノ$$.」

437:t_1:43.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$フェルト$$... Has $$クィーン$$ contacted us since then?」

437:t_1:44.en:
$$フェルト$$
「No. With such a vast information network, I think she must know what we're doing, though...」

437:t_1:45.en:
$$アルト$$
「So all we can do is wait... For $$クィーン$$, and for $n...」

437:t_1:49.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Captain's Quarters ～

437:t_1:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「...That concludes my report on $c's operations on the southern $$中央大陸$$ front.」

437:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Thank you for your hard work, Sergeant $$相良$$.」

437:t_1:52.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The $$霊子吸収システム$$, Miss $$スズネ$$'s attack, the truth about $$ジェニオン$$... It's one shock after another.」

437:t_1:53.en:
$$宗介$$
「However, morale is high. With the three $$リアクター$$s' increased combat strength, I foresee no major problems with our strategy.」

437:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Strategically, that may be true, but...」

437:t_1:56.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What happened to $l must also have been a shock to you and his other friends, mustn't it...?」

437:t_1:58.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I hear $$カレン$$ and the others have hardly left his bedside. You must also...」

437:t_1:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「...During the $$時獄戦役$$, I too found myself in the worst possible situation.」

437:t_1:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You mean what happened in $$香港$$.」

437:t_1:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「It may be unreasonable to compare myself with $n now, but I believe $n will overcome this obstacle.」

437:t_1:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's a man who can find hope within himself.」

437:t_1:67.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you fighting despair too, just like $l?」

437:t_1:69.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry. That was terribly intrusive of me.」

437:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... Please don't worry about it.」

437:t_1:71.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$千鳥$$ was kidnapped, I lost $$アル$$, $$ミスリル$$ was destroyed, and $$アマルガム$$ keeps rising with the Empire's help...」

437:t_1:72.en:
$$宗介$$
「You could say my situation is hopeless.」

437:t_1:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't intend to. I threw the very idea to the dogs long ago.」

437:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sure $n is the same. ...I don't know what despair lies deep in his heart, but he's a strong man.」

437:t_1:77.en:
$$宗介$$
「He just needs a little more... One small spark, and he'll wake up and fight again, just as he used to.」

437:t_1:78.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You believe in him... And in your ability to rescue $$カナメ$$.」

437:t_1:80.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you, $$相良$$. Your words have helped me strengthen my resolve too.」

437:t_1:82.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll do my best too. I'll take back Earth, save $$カナメ$$, defeat $$アマルガム$$...」

437:t_1:83.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And I'll settle things with my brother...」

437:t_1:85.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll need your help too, $$相良$$. Can I count on you?」
